title: Seven Safari Packing Mistakes to Avoid
excerpt: Too much luggage, the wrong colours and no warm layer: seven common safari packing mistakes and how to avoid them.
body:
Packing for a safari is different from packing for a beach holiday. These mistakes are common.

## 1. Too much luggage

Domestic flights have weight limits, and you need less than you think. Laundry is available in many lodges.

## 2. Bright or dark blue and black clothing

Tsetse flies are attracted to dark blue and black. Bright colours stand out. Choose khaki, beige, olive and grey.

## 3. No warm layer

Morning drives can be cold, especially in the Ngorongoro highlands. Bring a fleece and a windproof jacket.

## 4. A hard suitcase

Soft bags fit better in vehicles and small aircraft.

## 5. Forgetting binoculars

One pair per person makes a big difference.

## 6. Plastic bags

Plastic carrier bags are banned. See [the plastic bag ban](/blog/tanzania-plastic-bag-ban/).

## 7. No sun protection

A hat, sunglasses and sunscreen are essential.
